nodes.title: The child home never shows a signal the next screen breaks (§3.4, §6.3.3): (1) while GET /api/child/plan is in flight the PrimaryCard is a neutral busy card ('Getting today ready', aria-busy, NO Start, no Practice tile) instead of a provisional 'start' card with a live Start; (2) server state `resume` is shown as `start` ("Today's lesson" · Start) while src/child/plan.ts RESUME_BY_ID is false, because /c/:cid/lesson/:lid cannot reopen a lesson by id and 'Continue' would start a new one; the server state is kept as plan.serverState; (3) offline says 'Practice works offline.' and offers Quick practice ONLY when plan.packReady, else 'Lessons need the internet.' + Try again, and the Practice / Ask tiles are not offered offline. Reversal: (2) the lesson route resumes by id (flip RESUME_BY_ID); (3) an offline pack ships (packReady true); (1) the plan read becomes local-first (then the cached state may render, still without a Start until confirmed)

Child screens outside the lesson (.cs, .cs-gate) re-declare the band type tokens in rem (px/16, so 100 % renders identically) times one factor --cs-k (Me → Bigger text = 1.18): text follows the browser/OS font size to 200 % (§11.7) and Bigger text grows it. The lesson (no .cs) keeps the px tokens (it yields per §6.3.4, lesson workstream). Layout follows: grids use minmax(0,1fr), tiles reflow with auto-fit minmax(min(100%, n rem)), the top bar wraps only when one row no longer fits. Reversal: tokens.css itself moves the band scale to rem (then the re-declaration in src/child/child.css goes)

Bigger text as `.tx-child[data-comfort=large] { --t-body: calc(var(--t-body) + 3px) }` on the same element: a custom-property cycle, so every token in the rule became invalid at computed time and text fell back to the inherited 16 px; Older body text (17 px) got SMALLER when the child turned Bigger text on. Found by the fixer review in Chromium, not by the battery (it never toggled the setting). Fixed with a separate factor variable; the battery now asserts the computed size grows

Garden layout: each bed is a raised bed (brick edge + soil) that fills the panel from its signboard to the bottom, one bed per phone width (100cqw − gutters, max 340), so no hollow paper band sits above the plants and the seal is never clipped by the panel edge; a code-drawn courtyard ground (sky + clouds band holding the 64 dp arrows, hedge, soil) stands in for the failed bg/garden-panorama; each bed's signboard has its own token colour plus the topic picture (code-drawn subject emblem until topic art lands); the class's current chapter carries a flag picture whose accessible name is 'Your class is here'. Beds carry NO visible chapter name: §10 'Garden: plants, no words, no numbers' (R0/R1 readers), and a spoken label needs her voice for arbitrary text, which has no route. Reversal: MW-M2 / a child test shows Young children cannot tell beds apart, or a 'speak this chapter name' route exists

Notebook pages come from the lesson ids THIS device recorded (no server endpoint lists a child's lessons): the empty line only says 'after your first lesson' when the server plan says `first`; otherwise 'Your next lesson will add a page here.' (true on any device). Lesson summaries are immutable once ended, so each is fetched once and cached per child on the device, at most 3 in flight (was up to 12 parallel requests on every open). Reversal: GET /api/child/notebook (or recent lesson ids on the plan) exists; then the server list is the source and the device cache only a speed-up

B2 battery after the fixer pass, tests/e2e-design-b2.mjs: 1116/1116 checks (n = 1 run, headless Chromium SwiftShader, production build via server/serve.mjs, /api/* mocked; 360x640 DPR 2 touch + 1280x800; light + dark for Older). New since the 942-check run: V-TGT at the spec bars (48 Older/adult, 64 Young, the 48 dp Grown-ups door excepted) with negative controls (46 px and 60 px buttons trip); V-PLAN loading (plan delayed 3 s; capped/resting/done: 0 Start links and 0 Practice tiles at 1.2 s; control trips); resume shown as start; offline makes no offline-practice promise and offers no Practice/Ask; card region named by its own heading; Bigger text grows computed sizes (Older home title 24 → 28.3 px); text follows a 200 % root font size on home, map, notebook, me (Young + Older) with no off-screen clipping and no top-bar overlap (new off-screen check + control); V-CON text contrast against the composited pixels under it, 30 screen states, ≥ 4.5 / 3 (control trips); V-MOTION reduced motion leaves nothing looping (6 routes); Garden bed fills the panel, class flag present and in view, sheet shows the visible '{T} · AI teacher' label; Notebook summaries fetched once (3 on first open, 0 on reopen); V-ABS now varies the last-visit device state (plan cache day, day marker, artefact date) as well as the clock, compares text and primary-card pixels, with a control. V-SHOT-B2 image diff implemented (in-browser OffscreenCanvas YIQ, ΔE 0.1, ≤ 0.5 %) but SKIPPED for all 141 shots: no human-approved baselines exist in tests/visual/baselines/b2/. V-PERF-1 max 66 KB art per child route. Not a device, child or parent measurement

gen-assets re-run after more of the Codex pack landed: 150 images shipped (was 22), 0 passthrough; 87 ids still pending in INDEX.json; 4 failed/skipped by the Codex run (bg/who-wide, bg/who-phone, bg/garden-panorama, topics/bead-pattern); 18 teacher stills missing; 1 lamp-hue lint failure (picto/notebook 2.16 % > 1.5 %, not shipped: its drawn fallback renders). OCR still not run (no AZURE_VISION_*). n = 1 run, ImageMagick 6 + libwebp

Left open by the B2 fixer: (1) server owner: GET /api/child/notebook (lesson ids + best card + her one line) so the Notebook is not device-bound, plus no-cache for /assets/gen/manifest.json in server/serve.mjs; (2) lesson owner: resume a lesson by id (then flip RESUME_BY_ID), send LessonStartRequest.purpose, honour prefs.face / largeText on the Desk; (3) parent owner: server-held speech text for the four onboarding promise rows (§6.2 step 3 '▶'), reachable before an account exists; the consent rows' CONSENT_SPEECH still says 'she'; (4) B1 owner: src/ui/Art.tsx and src/child/art.tsx each fetch the manifest; make one delegate to the other (one table); <Teacher> loads the stage background when not shown; (5) human: approve the first V-SHOT-B2 baselines (`--update-baselines`), the B2-A2 review sheet; (6) not built: the Young 1280 painted beds as tap targets (the Garden tile is in the panel instead), her greeting line, Hear {T} / How I know / the child's made thing in the map sheet, Your teacher preview clips (stills shown), onboarding step 8 (counter says 'of 8'), the sky SVG labels stay px (the List view is the scalable source of truth), re-run gen-assets after picto/notebook is regenerated

md.decisions:
## b2-home-no-lying-signal
src/child/plan.ts (`RESUME_BY_ID`, `practiceOffered`, `serverState`, `packReady`, LOADING), src/child/screens/Home.tsx (loading card, offline by packReady, aria-labelledby on the card). Unit-tested in tests/ui-v2-b2.test.mjs. This keeps b2-home-plan-fallback's fallback rules (404/5xx/timeout → start with cached topic; done marker; offline) and adds the three no-lie rules.

## b2-child-type-rem
src/child/child.css top block. The rule `.tx-child :is(.cs, .cs-gate)` scopes it; ChildScreen and Hello both render `.cs`.

## b2-garden-raised-beds
src/child/progress/Garden.tsx (GardenGround, BedSign, SubjectEmblem, HereFlag). Still only started beds + the class's chapter (gardenBeds, unchanged); this node supersedes b2-garden-started-beds only in layout, the bed-selection rule stands.

## b2-notebook-device-source
src/child/screens/Notebook.tsx (`SUMMARY_CONCURRENCY`, localStorage key taxila.child.<cid>.nbsum).

md.rejected:
## b2-rejected-custom-property-cycle
Reproduced in Chromium: computed --t-body was the guaranteed-invalid value, font-size resolved to the inherited 16 px. Also found: the old V-TGT used 44 px against its own 48 px header, which hid 44 px segmented controls (Me, Sky subject switcher); the old V-PLAN waited 900 ms, so it never saw the pre-answer Start card; the old 200 % check did not exist and an overflow-hidden page clips instead of scrolling, so a scroll check alone cannot see it (now an off-screen box check against the emulated width, because a mobile page that overflows zooms out and innerWidth grows with it).
